queries.result: Search identified the official Shangyu natural-resources branch document describing unified natural-resource/real-estate registration, cadastral investigation and the district registration information platform, plus an official basic-survey plan describing a district natural-resources atlas. No anonymous public parcel geometry service was identified.

registryEvidence: The official Shangyu government-hosted natural-resources branch document identifies the branch as responsible for unified natural-resource and real-estate registration, cadastral investigation, cadastral surveying, and management/sharing of registration materials. This establishes a local custodial authority, not an open parcel API.
sourceScope: Shangyu District, Shaoxing, Zhejiang, China; local custodial evidence and the province-wide public GIS portal were inspected. Citywide open parcel coverage was not established.
